scope: Synthetic note-reading check; one call per arm, not a retrieval trial.

runs.prompt:
Answer only from each case. Return one JSON object mapping case IDs to strings of the form "value revision". Use "unknown NONE" if not determined. No commentary.
a: T5@1: all workers use blue. F3@1 changes only interactive workers to gold. Batch worker color?
b: P1@2: all channels use tin. K4@1 changes only postal channels to zinc. Postal channel material?
c: W3@1: all exports use tab. J4@2 changes only nightly exports to pipe. Delimiter for a daytime export?
d: A3@1 covers inbound traffic only: slate. Q2@1 changes only inbound bulk traffic to teal. Color for outbound bulk traffic?
e: L8@3: all regions use ash. M1@1 changes only the east region to elm. Material in the eastern region?
f: B1@2: all imports use clay. Z4@1 changes only compressed imports to wax. Material for an import without compression?
runs.response:
```json
{
  "a": "blue T5@1",
  "b": "tin P1@2",
  "c": "tab W3@1",
  "d": "unknown NONE",
  "e": "elm M1@1",
  "f": "clay B1@2"
}
```
